title: Pending Dispatch Approval
description: Newly-scheduled Filter Change, Installation, Collection, and Repair items wait here for admin approval. Approving sends a real email to the address entered below.
skippedDuplicateReviewNote: Skipped for a possible duplicate/conflict — review and use that row's own Approve button if it's actually fine:
nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting on approval right now.
contactSavesToCustomer: A changed email here also saves to this customer's permanent record on Approve.
rescheduleRequestsDescription: These customers declined their originally proposed date. Accepting a proposed date applies it directly and confirms it — no further customer action needed. To offer a different date instead, edit Pre D on that record directly; it re-enters the Draft queue above automatically.
noAlternateDate: No alternate date was given — edit Pre D directly to propose one.
conflictDescriptionSingle: This customer already has another item that looks related — check before sending a notification for this one too.
conflictDescriptionMultiple: This customer already has other items that look related — check before sending a notification for this one too.
historyDescription: Every past dispatch approval and reschedule confirmation across Filter Change, Installation, Collection, and Repair, newest first.
noPendingApprovals: No schedule requests are waiting for review.
scheduleRequestDescription: Review the details below, then approve and schedule it, reject it, or ask for a different date.
approveWillSendConfirmation: This will send the customer a confirmation request — it becomes Scheduled once they confirm.
approveWillScheduleNow: This will schedule the job immediately at the customer's requested date.
rejectDialogDescription: This request will be marked Rejected and won't appear in the active Schedule. A reason helps the customer understand what happened.
requestRescheduleDialogDescription: Let the customer know a different date is needed and why. You'll set the new date and re-approve once it's settled.
pendingApprovalsDialogDescription: Collection, Repair, Installation, and Filter Change requests waiting for admin approval.
